verdicts.reason: Both are unusable. In both, the forest background stays a narrow centre strip on a white banner, so the white headline and body copy sitting on white disappear. Only clipped fragments survive ('oted/Day', 'Joint cele…', 'Investing in…'), the cream divider lines float off the image, and 'March 21' sits stranded in pale yellow on white. B is slightly worse: its 'Joint celeb' line sits on the light sky band with poor contrast, its headline fragments are even shorter ('ed/y'), and stray faint yellow marks are scattered on the left.
